means.example-sentence: I want you to just imagine what it would feel like to live in extreme poverty as he did.
means.sentence-jp: 彼がそうしてきた極貧の中で暮らすことがどんなものか、あなたにちょっと想像してもらいたい。

cloze.maskedText: I want you to just imagine ____ to live in extreme poverty as he did.

notes: 様子を尋ねる表現。動詞には be, look, sound, taste, feel などがよく使われる。
